title: improv·artist · monumental (Anish Kapoor)
mutation_directive: improv artist: monumental via Anish Kapoor

improv_extras.practice: void, mirror, blood-red pigment, scale; the form opens onto absence

v1.feedback: The Kapoor brief lands — blood-red paraboloid vessel with void-black nadir is legible in 2s and the differential growth gives the rim organic crinkle rather than a sterile bowl. To push it: the void center should be actual absence (discard particles below a t-threshold so the nadir is empty screen-black, not dark-red particles), which would make the 'opening onto absence' concept visceral rather than illustrative. The interpolated fill particles read as uniform dust — vary their density by curvature so crinkled rim areas are pigment-thick and smooth zones breathe. Slow auto-rotation is fine but consider a very subtle camera drift downward into the bowl mouth to sell monumental scale through parallax.

v2.feedback: The void-as-literal-absence concept lands well and the differential-growth rim gives organic crinkle that justifies the particle medium. Blood-red darkening into true black center is restrained and on-brief. To push toward monumental: scale the rim radius up and start camera closer/inside the mouth so the viewer feels swallowed by the form rather than observing a bowl from outside — right now the initial framing reads as 'object on table' not 'architecture you enter'. Consider adding a subtle subsurface-scatter glow at the rim edge (emissive additive pass) to sell the Kapoor pigment-so-red-it-flattens-depth effect, and let the camera descent be slower with slight tilt to delay revealing the void floor.
